title: Takeoff — Mauritius FIMP
description: Edelweiss Air A340 ready for engine start on runway 14, Mauritius. Sunrise. Heavy. Long haul to Zürich.
author: Markus Leutwyler

atcClearances.atc: Edelweiss nine one seven, taxi to holding point runway one four via Alpha and Bravo, QNH one zero one three

atcClearances.pm: Holding point runway one four, Edelweiss nine one seven, ready
atcClearances.atc: Edelweiss nine one seven, wind one three zero at twelve, runway one four, cleared for takeoff

debrief: Did all 4 engines start cleanly — any N1 anomalies?
